mapper.select: select a.id, a.plan_id, a.plan_name, a.flight_route_id, a.`status`, a.plan_type, a.device_code, a.plan_time as plan_time_a, a.uav_nest_code, a.plan_end_time, a.plan_start_time, a.regular_execution_date, a.cycle_execution_unit, a.day_interval, a.interval_values, a.gain_video, a.auto, a.gain_data_mode, a.tenant_id, a.industry_code, a.app_ver_code, a.create_time, a.create_user, a.update_time, a.update_user, a.delete_flag, a.access_node, a.accept_node,a.uav_code,a.is_it_enabled,a.cycle_execution_time,d.device_name,l.flight_route_name, l.extra_field,l.type,i.device_name as uav_nest_name,a.video_definition,a.auto_resume,a.risk_msg_switch FROM vm_air_plan_t a LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t d ON a.uav_code = d.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_info i on a.uav_nest_code = i.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t l on a.flight_route_id = l.flight_route_id where a.plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_air_plan_t (`plan_id`, `plan_name`, `flight_route_id`, `status`, `plan_type`, `device_code`, `plan_time`, `uav_nest_code`, `plan_end_time`, `plan_start_time`, `regular_execution_date`, `cycle_execution_unit`, `day_interval`, `interval_values`, `gain_video`, `auto`, `gain_data_mode`, `tenant_id`, `industry_code`, `app_ver_code`, `create_time`, `create_user`,`delete_flag`, `access_node`, `accept_node`, `uav_code`, `is_it_enabled`, `cycle_execution_time`,`snapshot_id`,video_definition, auto_resume,risk_msg_switch) VALUES (#{planId}, #{planName}, #{flightRouteId}, #{status}, #{planType}, #{deviceCode}, #{planTime}, #{uavNestCode}, #{planEndTime}, #{planStartTime}, #{regularExecutionDate}, #{cycleExecutionUnit}, #{dayInterval}, #{intervalValues}, #{gainVideo}, #{auto}, #{gainDataMode}, #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, #{appVerCode}, now(), #{createUser}, '0', #{accessNode}, #{acceptNode},#{uavCode},#{isItEnabled},#{cycleExecutionTime},#{snapshotId},#{definition},#{autoResume},#{riskMsgSwitch});
mapper.select: SELECT plan_name from vm_air_plan_t WHERE plan_id = #{planId};

select id, plan_id, plan_name, flight_route_id, status, plan_type, device_code, plan_time as plan_time_a, uav_nest_code, plan_end_time, plan_start_time, regular_execution_date, cycle_execution_unit, day_interval, interval_values, gain_video, auto, gain_data_mode, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user, delete_flag, access_node, accept_node,uav_code,is_it_enabled,cycle_execution_time FROM vm_air_plan_t a where plan_id = #{planId} and delete_flag = 0
